name: @spell-app/spaces
description: Where projects and people live, and the servers that serve them:  the editor's, and Python's web server

scripts.review:
yarn ts && yarn lint:fix && yarn format && yarn test && echo '== REVIEW PASSED
===========
'
scripts.ts:
echo '>>>>>>>>>>>
>> RUNNING TSC' && tsc && tsc -p tsconfig.node.json && tsc -p ../../tests/spaces && echo '<< TSC PASSED
'
scripts.lint:
echo '>>>>>>>>>>>
>> LINTING WITH OXLINT + RUFF' && vp lint --report-unused-disable-directives --max-warnings 0 src && (cd ../../tests/spaces && vp lint --report-unused-disable-directives --max-warnings 0 .) && uv run --directory src/server/py ruff check . ../../../../../tests/spaces/src/server/py/tests && echo '<< OXLINT + RUFF PASSED
'
scripts.lint:fix:
echo '>>>>>>>>>>>
>> LINTING WITH OXLINT + RUFF --fix' && vp lint --fix src && (cd ../../tests/spaces && vp lint --fix .) && uv run --directory src/server/py ruff check --fix . ../../../../../tests/spaces/src/server/py/tests && echo '<< OXLINT + RUFF PASSED
'
scripts.format:
echo '>>>>>>>>>>>
>> FORMATTING WITH OXFMT + RUFF' && vp fmt . && (cd ../../tests/spaces && vp fmt .) && uv run --directory src/server/py ruff format . ../../../../../tests/spaces/src/server/py/tests && echo '<< OXFMT + RUFF PASSED
'
scripts.format:check: vp fmt --check . && (cd ../../tests/spaces && vp fmt --check .) && uv run --directory src/server/py ruff format --check . ../../../../../tests/spaces/src/server/py/tests
scripts.test:
echo '>>>>>>>>>>>
>> RUNNING TESTS' && vp test run && uv run --directory src/server/py pytest -q && echo '<< TESTS PASSED
'
